Krawall.et: Unknown. Perhaps borrowed from Late Latin charavallium (“noise and clamor at a wedding”), or from Old French chalivali (“noise from pots and pans”) or charivali (compare French charivari), from Late Latin caribaria or Late Latin carivaria, ultimately from Anci…

Krawatte.et: Borrowed from French cravate. Compare English cravat and Spanish corbata. Doublet of Kroate (“Croat”).
